Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is iGimkit official?

A: No. iGimkit is a 100% fan-made project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or partnered with Gimkit, Inc. All official Gimkit images, names, character designs, and assets used across this website belong entirely to their respective creators. This platform is built strictly as a free, educational utility for the community.

Q: What inspired this project?

A: This website is heavily inspired by iBlooket, the fantastic fan hub built for the Blooket community. We loved how their token calculators and drop simulators brought players together, so we set out to build an equally powerful companion site dedicated entirely to Gimkit!

Q: Can I get banned for using iGimkit?

A: Absolutely not. iGimkit is entirely standalone. It does not interface with Gimkit's official live servers, modify your game files, or provide unfair cheats or game bots. It is a completely safe environment to simulate pack openings and test your game knowledge.

Q: Where do the pack odds and pictures come from?

A: The odds and item names come from the Gimkit fan wiki, and the pictures are from its pack pages. Gimkit can change pack odds at any time, so the numbers may occasionally be out of date. All Gimkit images and names belong to Gimkit, Inc.

Q: What's the difference between the Calculator and the Advanced Calculator?

A: The Calculator picks one pack and shows your chance and expected copies of every item in it, or simulates opening your packs. The Advanced Calculator follows one to three specific gims, drawing their chance as you spend more GimBucks and showing the exact chance of getting 0, 1, 2 or more copies.

Q: What does "Sell Duplicates" do?

A: When it's on, every duplicate you pull is sold straight away (5, 10, 25, 100 or 300 GimBucks, depending on rarity) and the coins are used to open more packs. Without it, you open one pack for every 30 GimBucks you start with.

About

iGimkit works out your odds of getting items from Gimkit packs. Pack odds and item names come from the Gimkit fan wiki, so they may be a little out of date. Without selling duplicates every number is calculated exactly. With selling turned on, the results are simulated because they depend on luck at every step.
